about: Statutory first-offense sentence ranges, in months of incarceration, for the offense keys the game uses (src/simulation/justice/prosecution.ts OFFENSE_LABELS), by place. Research only: nothing reads this file yet, and the existing prosecution calibration in prosecution.ts stays in force until the wiring is ruled on. Each offense row names the grade read, the statute section, the official source URL and a verbatim quote cut from that source. A row either points at a class in the place's classes table (where the place sets penalties by class) or carries its own minMonths and maxMonths. A place whose official code could not be read carries rows marked ESTIMATED FROM AVERAGE, with the method and the places that fed the average, and its unreadReason. Nothing here is shown to a player.

offenseDefinitions.crime:robbery: The least serious robbery grade: taking by force or threat with no weapon and no serious injury.
offenseDefinitions.crime:burglary: The base grade that covers unlawful entry into a dwelling with intent to commit a crime, with no weapon and no assault.
offenseDefinitions.crime:assault: The lowest felony-type assault for injuring, or assaulting, another with a deadly or dangerous weapon (the place's nearest grade where it has none).
offenseDefinitions.crime:vandalism: The lowest criminal mischief or property damage grade that carries any incarceration.
offenseDefinitions.campaign-funds-personal-use: Not yet read for any place; the federal and state campaign-finance penalty sections are the next research item.

conventions.units: Months of incarceration. Years are multiplied by 12; a day count is converted to whole months and the note gives the days, except a term under a month, which is kept to one decimal.
conventions.firstOffense: Ranges are for a first offense with no enhancement (habitual, hate, victim-class, or weapon-use add-ons excluded).
conventions.minMonths: The statutory minimum term; 0 where the statute sets only a maximum or allows probation or jail instead.
conventions.maxLife: Where the maximum is life imprisonment, maxMonths is null and maxLife is true.
conventions.presumptiveMonths: Set only where the statute itself names a presumptive term.
conventions.grid: Places with a sentencing grid or guideline system record the statutory class or offense maximum here, with gridNote naming the grid; grid cells are not parsed.
conventions.quoteCheck: "text" quotes were cut programmatically from the fetched official page text, so they appear verbatim in the source (with whitespace collapsed). "image-transcribed" quotes were read from a grid the official site publishes only as an image.
conventions.estimated: A place whose official code could not be read is marked ESTIMATED FROM AVERAGE: each row is the mean of the sourced places' rows for the same offense key (method, fedByMin and fedByMax on each row). No statute is cited for an estimated place.
